title: Unsupported docker/build-push-action runtime
summary: This release predates the action's Node.js 24 runtime. GitHub no longer provides Node.js 20 on Actions runners.

sources.title: Node 20 is no longer available in GitHub Actions

constraints: Preserve the build context, tags, platforms, cache, and push settings; Node 24 needs Actions Runner v2.327.1 or later on self-hosted runners.

steps.title: Upgrade build-push-action
steps.instructions: Change the uses reference to docker/build-push-action@v7 or a later supported major.

steps.title: Review build-push-action inputs
steps.instructions: Compare configured inputs with the target release and update renamed or changed options; confirm the runner meets the release's minimum version.
